name: Proton Calendar
description: Open Proton Calendar on today or any date
author: spotty
help:
Optional Proton Calendar trigger

Installing adds the `cal` trigger and a Proton Calendar row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. `cal` opens calendar.proton.me on today; type a date such as `cal 2026-10-24`, `cal tomorrow` or `cal yesterday` to jump straight to that day.

Settings chooses the default view (day, week or month) and which signed-in Proton account to open, matching the account order in Proton's account switcher.

Proton has no Linux desktop calendar client, so Spotty opens Proton's web app in your default browser. Sign-in happens on Proton's website; Spotty never sees or stores Proton credentials or calendar data. Uninstalling removes the trigger only.
